name: RC-135 Rivet Joint (and variants)
summary: Family of four-engine reconnaissance aircraft built on the C-135 airframe, chiefly the RC-135V/W Rivet Joint signals-intelligence platform.

wings: Low-mounted swept wing with dihedral, as on the KC-135
Cobra Ball has its right wing painted black
engines: Four high-bypass turbofans in fat nacelles on pylons
fuselage: Long 'hog nose' thimble radome extending ahead of the cockpit
Long bulged antenna fairings ('cheeks') along both sides of the forward fuselage
Rows of blade and wire antennas under the belly; no refueling boom at the tail
tail: Tall swept single fin, as on the KC-135

tellTales: Long bulged fairings along both sides of the forward fuselage
Rows of small blade antennas under the belly

confusedWith.howToTell: The RC-135 has a long thimble nose, cheek fairings and belly antennas with no boom; the KC-135 has a plain nose and a refueling boom under the tail.
The RC-135 has a thimble nose and cheek fairings; the E-6 is longer with wingtip pods and a plain nose.
The RC-135 has cheek fairings and no radar disc; the E-3 carries a large rotating disc on struts above the fuselage.

usCount.source: USAF RC-135V/W, RC-135S, RC-135U and WC-135 fact sheets
